notes.title: 🔥 Act 2 is in Development + More Side Quests Coming! 🔥
notes.content:
[p]Hey adventurers! 🗺️[/p][p]I just wanted to give you a quick update on what's happening behind the scenes here at [i]Chronicles of Veldoria[/i].[/p][p]As mentioned before, I’m now working with a new story writer to help bring more life, twists, and depth to the world of Veldoria—and I’m super excited about what’s coming next. 🎭✨[/p][p]💥 [b]Act 2 is officially in development![/b]
Expect brand-new maps, regions, cutscenes, monsters, and new game mechanics that expand upon everything you’ve seen so far.[/p][p]🧩 [b]Act 1 will also receive more side quests![/b]
I want to make sure the early game feels even more alive with extra lore, rewards, and meaningful NPC interactions. New secrets and optional battles are on the way.[/p][p]🎮 [b]Other improvements on the horizon[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]More polish and QoL features[/p][/*][*][p]Additional monster fusion content[/p][/*][*][p]And maybe even some surprises 👀[/p][/*][/list][p]I’m a solo developer (programmer + designer) who’s had my fair share of struggles—but I put my heart into this project. Thank you to everyone who’s supported the game so far. Your feedback, bug reports, and kind words mean the world to me.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates—and if you're enjoying the game, let others know by leaving a review or sharing the page![/p][p]💚 With gratitude,
~ Gene / Next Level Gaming[/p]

notes.title: If You Enjoyed the Game, Please Consider Leaving a Review! 🙏
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]I want to thank all of you who’ve taken the time to check out Chronicles of Veldoria. It means a lot, especially as a solo/indie developer trying to make this project the best it can be.[/p][p]If you’ve played the game and enjoyed it, even just parts of it, I’d be incredibly grateful if you could leave an honest review. Your feedback doesn’t just help me improve the game—it also helps other players discover it.[/p][p]Whether it’s just a quick sentence or a longer write-up, every review makes a huge difference. 💬[/p][p]I’m continuing to work on improvements and updates, including rewriting dialogue, improving the battle system, having better cutscenes, and expanding the story, so your thoughts really help shape the future of the game.[/p][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey![/p][p]– Gene, Next Level Gaming[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Thank You! Average Playtime Passes 1 Hour! 🎮
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]I wanted to share something really special — [b]the average playtime for [i]Chronicles of Veldoria[/i] has just passed 1 hour[/b]! 🎉
That might not sound huge at first, but for a relatively short game (2–3 hours in its current Early Access form), this means [b]a lot of you are staying and playing through[/b].
As a solo dev who's put heart and soul into this project, this truly means the world to me.[/p][p]🙏 Thank you so much for giving the game a chance.[/p][p]Now, I’d love to hear from you:[/p][list][*][p]💬 What hooked you in the game?[/p][/*][*][p]🧭 What did you enjoy the most — story, combat, exploration, characters?[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ What would you like to see improved or expanded?[/p][/*][/list][p]Every bit of feedback helps me make the game better — and I read everything you post.[/p][p]You can reply here or leave a comment in the community discussions. I’ll be checking in often. And if you haven’t yet, a review would also help a ton 💙[/p][p]Thank you again,
— Gene, Developer of [i]Chronicles of Veldoria[/i][/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes Improvements on 07/15/2025
notes.content:
I have fixed the issues with collisions, overflowing text and that god-awful bug where using items from the regular menu (outside of battle) causes the game to crash. My most sincere apologies about these issues (especially item one).

There are many other changes here, but you still don't get past Act 1. I made this update because I hadn't made one in months while working on it. I will try to work on Act 2 now. I hope that I did everything right here.

notes.title: 💫 A Fresh Look and Exciting Progress for Chronicles of Veldoria
notes.content:
[p]Hello adventurers,[/p][p]You may have noticed that the game's store page just got a visual update — the new banner art is now live! I hope it gives a better feel for the world and energy of [i]Chronicles of Veldoria[/i]. This is just one of many things happening behind the scenes.[/p][p]As I mentioned in a previous post, I’ve brought on a talented [b]story writer[/b] to help breathe even more life into the world and its characters. In parallel, my [b]mapper is hard at work[/b] crafting new areas for you to explore — expanding the world of Veldoria and deepening the journey.[/p][p]I’m still handling all the programming and design on my own. I won’t lie — as a solo developer, it’s been a challenging road, and I’ve had my share of struggles. But this game truly has my heart. Every mechanic, every ability, every dialogue box — I’ve poured everything I could into making this a unique and personal experience.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has supported the project so far — by playing the demo, leaving feedback, or just wishlisting. You’ve helped keep this dream alive.[/p][p]Stay tuned — more updates and content are on the way soon.[/p][p]With gratitude,
[b]Gene,[/b] [b]Next Level Gaming[/b]
Developer of [i]Chronicles of Veldoria[/i][/p]

notes.title: Exciting Updates Coming to Chronicles of Veldoria!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]First off, thank you to everyone who has played, wishlisted, or shared feedback on Chronicles of Veldoria. I know the game isn't perfect yet—and I truly appreciate your patience and support.[/p][p]I'm excited to share that I've recently brought a new writer on board! We're working together to improve the story and dialogue significantly and I will also work on the gameplay. I will be working on revising Act 1 and continue the story. This will take some time, but the goal is to create a much more engaging and immersive experience.[/p][p]I’ll keep you updated as things progress. In the meantime, feel free to share any feedback—every bit helps us make the game better![/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey. 🙏[/p][p]– Next Level Gaming[/p]

notes.content: [p]Some people have pointed out that my game doesn't launch like it should via the Steam app. I am sorry for this! I have tried fixing it. Please try it out now and let me know somewhere. I am still pretty new to SteamWorks. Also, you can launch the game's demo via double-clicking the Game.exe file in the installed directory of my game. It is in the "Chronicles of Veldoria" folder. I apologize once again![/p]
